extension.summary: Collects Kodi crashes and errors, groups repeats, files issues
extension.description: Tails kodi.log, captures Python tracebacks, error lines and crash logs, normalizes them into signatures, groups repeating problems locally and files (or updates) GitHub issues in the configured repository.
extension.news:
0.2.1 - New icon and source categories: Add-ons, System and Kodi - Browse each add-on separately; source inference also works on existing reports
0.2.0 - Open Bug Tracker from Program add-ons to view grouped errors and crash reports - Browse by frequency, recent occurrence or report type; open full group details - Settings and manual sending are available from the browser - New-group notifications are optional and off by default
0.1.0 - First release: log tailing, traceback/error/crash capture, local grouping, GitHub issue filing with deduplication
